purpose: Bounded shadow measurement of same-model person masks; no production changes
running_mode: VIDEO; every clip frame processed in original order; native rounded PTS, no jumps to query frames

parameters.mask_sampling: bilinear at fixed source-image xy; last row/column edge value retained
parameters.mask_candidate_association: ordinal in same new SDK result; count/shape/missing mismatch remains missing
parameters.selection: existing unchanged PitcherSelector on new candidates; old selected index never used
parameters.mask_read_policy: Float32 numpy_view native abort verified twice; fail closed, no probabilities or inferred masks

limits: Same model mask and pose errors may correlate; not independent identity evidence.
Sparse targeted development queries cannot yield full-mask IoU, full-clip accuracy or Phase2 acceptance.
Question coordinates are sampled after inference; they never influence detection, selection, masks or ROI.
